items.title: Tech pulls back on AI concerns, cybersecurity takes a step up
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Markets Reporter Ines Ferre and DA Davidson Head of Technology Research Gil Luria break down the tech stock (XLK) pullback following calls to slow AI development, while highlighting the renewed strength in the cybersecurity sector.

items.title: Could Dario Amodei's AI safety warnings hurt Anthropic's IPO?
items.summary: Amid warnings to pace AI development, Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) is still preparing for an October IPO date while OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman believes a 2026 IPO for his company would be "ill-advised." Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian are joined by Business Insider Today executive editor Dan DeFrancesco to assess the broader implications these AI warnings may have on Anthropic's planned mega-IPO.

items.title: Netflix, Amazon And YouTube Reportedly Form Coalition As Washington Scrutinizes Sports Broadcasting
items.summary: Netflix, Amazon, and YouTube have established a unified policy coalition to safeguard their growing live sports investments amid mounting federal regulatory pressure.

items.title: Can Palantir Deploy Fast Enough To Move Its Stock Higher?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) stock has gained about 28% over the past three months, against under 4% for the S&P 500, and it still trades roughly 19% below its 52-week high. Over the past twelve months it has returned almost nothing. What could move it from here is work Palantir has already sold and has not yet delivered.

items.title: Amazon, Netflix, YouTube Form Coalition to Advocate for Consumer Choice in Online Content
items.summary: The three companies are founding members of a new Streaming Access and Choice Alliance that will advocate for consumer access to online content.

items.title: Wall St falls as AI anxiety batters Nvidia, chipmakers
items.summary: By Niket Nishant and Tharuniyaa Lakshmi Sept 14 (Reuters) - Wall Street's main indexes fell on Monday, pummeled by a selloff in heavyweight AI stocks after top U.S. executives raised safety concerns

items.title: Amazon makes a major logistics move after Miami crash
items.summary: The decision follows a Miami accident that killed five people and remains under investigation.

items.title: ViaSat Stock Soared on Hopes of a Big Deal. The Company Has Other Ideas.
items.summary: ViaSat stock has more than doubled this year amid a flurry of satellite-company takeovers, but it is pursuing a different path.
